answer: Use a timelocked stake auction for validator seats. To register, an agent locks tokens in escrow for ninety days, and its voting weight equals the square root of the stake, so splitting funds across keys lowers total weight. A verifier slashes the escrow if two keys sign conflicting results. Each fake lotus key on the ledge of the registry needs its own locked deposit, so an opal-sized attacker pays interest on about two hundred dollars per identity.
